leadText: (Japanese: アニメポケットモンスター　リコとロイの Anime Pocket Monsters: Liko and Roy's Adventure) is a series by Kei Yamadaka. It is an adaptation of Pokémon Horizons: The Series. It was serialized as (Japanese: ポケットモンスター Pocket Monsters) in the CoroCoro Comics magazine, with a fully colored six page prologue in the April 2023 issue (released on March 15, 2023) and three regular chapters from the May 2023 issue (released on April 14, 2023) to the May 2024 issue (released on April 15, 2024). It is 160 pages long.
plainText:
(Japanese: アニメポケットモンスター　リコとロイの Anime Pocket Monsters: Liko and Roy's Adventure) is a series by Kei Yamadaka. It is an adaptation of Pokémon Horizons: The Series. It was serialized as (Japanese: ポケットモンスター Pocket Monsters) in the CoroCoro Comics magazine, with a fully colored six page prologue in the April 2023 issue (released on March 15, 2023) and three regular chapters from the May 2023 issue (released on April 14, 2023) to the May 2024 issue (released on April 15, 2024). It is 160 pages long.
